sourceBinding.reason: Object-owned recipe: the datasets, their pinned program and bands, the stated conventions and the published geometry each is checked against.

The publisher's color map the dust dataset is shown in, read from the published figure as the file itself records (the color bar of Su et al. (2017), Figure 3, right panel, decoded from the figure in the paper's arXiv source: linear in signal-to-noise ratio, labelled from −7 to 35. The paper gives the noise of the map made from both data sets as 7.5 µJy per beam (section 3.1); times that, the listed colors run from −52.33 to 261.98 µJy per beam. Reading the bar's unit as that noise is this recipe's, not a statement of the paper's caption).
